faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Answers to the questions we hear most often.

items.question: Do we have to deploy an agent or a connector inside our tenant?
items.answer: No. Zelynto uses Microsoft Graph through an Entra ID application that you create in a few minutes. No server-side install, no agent to push to endpoints.

items.question: Which Microsoft Graph permissions are required?
items.answer: Scope is tuned to the modules you enable. For exploration and audit, read permissions are enough (Directory.Read.All, AuditLog.Read.All). Provisioning adds the matching writes.

items.question: Does my data leave my environment?
items.answer: Graph queries are issued from Zelynto, but no tenant data is kept by default beyond the duration of the conversation. You can enable an on-prem action log for traceability.

items.question: How do automated actions work?
items.answer: Every action goes through a readable preview first — creating a group, changing a policy, archiving a site. Nothing runs without your explicit confirmation.

items.question: Is Zelynto suited to MSPs managing multiple tenants?
items.answer: Yes. The Enterprise plan is designed for multi-tenant setups: context isolation, per-client audit rules and a consolidated dashboard.

items.question: How long does it take to get started?
items.answer: Less than an hour between creating the Entra ID app, connecting Zelynto, and running your first exploration session.
